# SOP-03: Confirming orders the day they arrive

## Purpose

This procedure is how item 3 of the new process is done. [map/future.md item 3]

## Who does what

| role | does |
|---|---|
| operations manager | reads the confirmation view each morning |
| order coordinator | settles the lines that hold an order back |

## When

Every working day. [map/future.md item 3]

## Steps

1. Each order is confirmed to the customer the day it arrives, once its lines are in the sheet. [map/future.md item 3]
2. The operations manager checks yesterday's orders were confirmed (software step: see the Operations manager guide, "Read the confirmation view at the start of the day"). [SC-11]

## Exceptions and who handles them

An order not confirmed has a line on the exceptions list; the order coordinator settles it. [SC-04]

## Escalation

The operations manager calls the customer for an order held more than a day. [map/roles.md operations manager]

## Records kept

The confirmation view shows each order's confirmation. The client has not said how long these are kept; ask before setting a period.

## Review

Review this procedure by 16 August 2027, or sooner when the process changes. [user-stated 2027-02-03]
